info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Transaction Update Management API
info.description: The Transaction Update Management API enables businesses to modify existing transaction records within the banking account management system. This operation allows users to update transaction details, ensuring accurate financial reporting and account management. Typical consumers of this API include banking personnel and financial applications that require real-time transaction updates. Use cases may involve correcting errors in transaction records or adjusting transaction amounts as needed. This API supports efficient transaction handling in dynamic banking environments.

patch.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific transaction engine resource identified by its unique ID (RES-100045). Ensure all required fields are included for a successful update.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the transaction details in the account management system. This operation allows for partial updates to the transaction resource identified by RES-100045, ensuring that only the specified fields are modified.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
